quality.review_scope: Independent complete five-page main scientific audit passed for all seven figures, three tables, equation and eleven references. SI and cited references remain unreviewed. Presentation refinements pending; no measured-coordinate admission.
missing_fields: Complete supplied five-page main read textually and visually. Cited full texts and distinct SI unreviewed. Independent scientific comparison passed; presentation pending.
Nitric acid is 69% but the percentage basis is unspecified. No density, moles, final mixture volume or additive-volume calculation is introduced.

Vigorous/continuous stirring speeds, addition temperature, heating ramps, gas atmosphere, storage duration and vessel closure are unknown unless explicitly stated. Room temperature remains qualitative.

Microwave vessel capacity and cooling/workup are unspecified. Its temperatures are correlations from vaporization enthalpy tables, not measured probe temperatures. TAP is the source abbreviation; its expansion is not defined.
The 2 h cooling and 24 h standing belong only to S2 convection treatment. They are not inherited by S3 or S4.

All samples are split equally; only one half is dried at 80°C for 3 h for analysis. The entire colloidal preparation is not silently converted to dried powder. Exact independent physical batches are unknown.

Scherrer crystallite sizes, TEM particle distributions, Raman peak heights and normalized half-height widths remain distinct. No absolute crystallinity, refined unit cell, atom coordinates or measured CIF is supplied.
Table 3 peak-height units are not printed. Values are retained as source-relative peak heights with unit unknown, not an invented intensity calibration.
Figure 1/7 labels, Figure 6 specimen and brookite reference conflicts remain unresolved. No curve digitization or image-derived size measurement performed.
Source figures have publisher permission unverified; artwork is conceptual. Bibliography identification does not imply reading cited full texts.
conflicts: Table 1 explicitly assigns S3 to 30 psi, correlated 121.5°C and TAP 10 min, and S4 to 60 psi, correlated 145°C and TAP 5 min. Figure 1 and Figure 7 plot keys instead print microwave 5 min at 30 PSI and 10 min at 60 PSI. Table-labeled canonical conditions are preserved alongside the contradictory plot keys; no guessed reconciliation.

Figure 1 caption assigns a=S1 and b=S2, while its plot key labels a=hydrothermally treated and b=colloidal TiO2. Panel-specific sample identity is therefore unresolved; the caption and key remain separate.

Figure 7 caption assigns a=S1, b=S4, c=S3, d=S2; its plot key instead labels a=microwave 5 min 30 PSI, b=microwave 10 min 60 PSI, c=colloidal TiO2, d=hydrothermally treated. No exact curve-to-recipe mapping is silently inferred.

Main p.4 prose identifies the microwave electron-diffraction specimen as S3, but Figure 6 caption identifies S4. Figure 6 is shared ambiguous microwave context and not evidence of a separately identified S3 or S4 physical batch.

Brookite reference is PDF 29-1360 in p.2 prose but PDF 26-1360 in Figure 5 caption. Both printed designations remain visible; no corrected reference number or measured crystallographic file is supplied.

Main p.4 compares 544 W microwave for 12 min with 1300 W convection for 15 h. Methods specify 630 ± 50 W nominal oven power at 80%, 2 min ramp and the Table 1 TAP times. The comparison is attributed source prose, not a substituted power setting or recomputed energy.
The p.3 XRD peak-intensity/defect-plane explanation is preserved as author interpretation. It is not used to infer an absolute defect density or crystallinity percentage.
